encoding: JSON sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8; result is lowercase SHA-256 hex
exclusions: Flow execution generation, which is persisted separately
reason: The worker must persist a secret-free local launch intent before PREPARE. Both worker and server therefore derive the same generation identity from the selected worker and exact StreamWorkerPrincipal without adding a poll response field or a second hashing implementation.
scope: Implementation refinement of the frozen NI2-012 durable launch journal; no wire field, route, lifecycle state, authority or acceptance-criteria change.
